Your bar. Your plates.

The calculator uses the fewest plates per side, with the heaviest inside. If your rack cannot make a load, choose one of the closest loads shown. The address saves your selections so you can share the setup.

Warm-up suggestions use about 50, 70, and 90 percent of the target, adjusted to your plates. The Block app uses the warm-ups written in your workout.

Logging and plate drawings are free in Block. Set your equipment in Settings > Your gym. The AI trainer (Pro, iOS 27) can write warm-ups and propose your next targets.
